C:P2.4.text: First Aid Central is a Canadian owned and operated manufacturer of first aid kits and safety supplies. For over 10 years, we have been a trusted provider of cost effective first aid products for individuals and businesses in every industry no matter how big or small.

This builds on our commitment of offering first aid products that are both safe and effective.
